chapter_seo_title: Hai Family Wedding Scheme Unravels - Xiao Chen Trapped in Farce
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen is forced into a sham wedding as the Hai family schemes to save face after losing his backing. A toast from Dugu Jianmo offers the only sincerity in a hall of hypocrisy.
og_title: Hai Family Wedding Turns Into Political Trap for Xiao Chen
og_description: The Hai family proceeds with a wedding they regret, planning Xiao Chen's death, while he must play the role of a happy groom in a farce that tests his resolve.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen Plays the Groom in a Deadly Farce
twitter_description: Forced into a wedding by the Hai family's political schemes, Xiao Chen must navigate a hall of hypocrites and await assassins. Dugu Jianmo toasts him.
